About the Venue

A Gulberg III banquet hall for your big day

LUXE Marquee is a banquet hall located in Block N, Gulberg III, Lahore — one of the city's most central and well-connected neighbourhoods, easy for guests to reach from across Lahore.

The hall offers in-house catering with dine-in service, so your event's food is handled under one roof. Guests are looked after with spacious parking — both free and paid options — and the venue has wheelchair-accessible entrances, making it comfortable for elderly guests and families alike.

With a public rating of 4.3 from 750 reviews, LUXE Marquee is an established choice for weddings and family celebrations in Gulberg. For booking enquiries and date availability, message on WhatsApp or call the venue directly.

Facilities

What the venue offers

Facilities confirmed from the venue's public listings — everything your guests need for a smooth, comfortable event.

In-House Catering

Food is prepared and served by the venue's own catering team — one team looking after your complete event.

Dine-In Service

Proper sit-down dine-in service for your guests, so everyone is served comfortably at the event.

Spacious Parking

Generous parking space at the venue, so guests arriving by car are not left circling the block.

Free & Paid Parking

Both free and paid parking options are available at the venue — choose what suits your guests.

Wheelchair-Accessible Entrances

Step-free, wheelchair-accessible entrances make the venue welcoming for elderly guests and guests with mobility needs.

Rated 4.3 by Guests

A public rating of 4.3 stars from 750 reviews — real feedback from people who have held and attended events here.
